user.title: SEF: connection
user.description: Create a Home Assistant key under My Energy platform → API keys. The key is shown once.

meter.title: SEF: P1 meter (optional)
meter.description: Leave empty for the price and watchdog sensors only. The meter ID is the serial number of your P1 meter (letters and digits); SEF binds the first upload to it and rejects a different ID afterwards.

error.ongeldige_sleutel: SEF rejects this key (revoked, expired or without dossier:lezen).
error.niet_bereikbaar: SEF cannot be reached at this address.
error.onverwacht: Unexpected answer from SEF; see the log.
error.meter_ongeldig: Letters and digits only, 4 to 64 characters.
error.meter_nodig: A meter ID is required with meters.
